instrumented_command: Same binaries and controls with --repeat 1 --instrument and mutation-history-counts.json output.
limits: Runtime measurements overlapped two owned maintained-query qualification fixtures; timings do not isolate history overhead.
Historical 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-07 baselines are retained and differ in source revision/date and concurrent load.
Native turn counts expose the added staging boundary independently of wall time; provider requests are not fsync counts.
Twenty observations per case support the reported nearest-rank p95, not p99. The one-per-case instrumented run is not a distribution.
No latency SLO or sustainable arrival rate follows from this experiment.
